variable: This file provides results for all organisations in the 2025 NHS Staff Survey, spilt by organisation type.
It holds the data used to create the benchmark reports on the website.

Occupational group weight is applied except to questions ask for demographic or factual information. The questions and measures which are not weighted are: q1, q10a, q26d, q27a-c, q28, q29, q30, q31a, q32a-b, q38, q39a-b, q40, Three Class socio-economic background and Five Class socio-economic background.

The occupational group weight allows comparisons to be made within benchmark groups. Comparisons between benchmark groups should not be made, nor should those groups be combined, due to different staff mixes and contextual factors.

Note. 2023 results for People Promise element 4 ('We are safe and healthy'), two of its sub-scores ('Health and safety climate' and 'Negative experiences'), Q13a-d and Q14a-d are now reported using corrected data.
